key.name: superuser-highlight-color
key.description: Window highlight background while a superuser process such as sudo leads the terminal, as a CSS color; alpha is ignored. Empty uses the palette's color.

key.name: remote-highlight-color
key.description: Window highlight background while a remote process such as ssh leads the terminal, as a CSS color; alpha is ignored. Empty uses the palette's color.

key.name: telemetry-interval
key.description: Seconds between updates of the telemetry footer's network, CPU and memory readings.
